messages:
nina: Quick sync: different SDKs surface error metadata inconsistently (dotnet drops request_id, kotlin loses retry_hint). This breaks our telemetry and retry helpers in the quickstart sample.
yusuf: Ugh. can you paste small examples?
nina: dotnet: throws SdkException("Auth failed") and inner details are only in logs. kotlin: client.call() returns HttpException with message only.
devon: We need a v1 "error envelope" that every SDK maps to. Minimal fields: code, status, user_message, machine_message, retryable, retry_hint, request_id. Keep names explicit to avoid surprise.
yusuf: Suggest machine_message for raw server payload and user_message for friendly text. Also include a version field, e.g. envelope_version: "v1" so we can iterate.
nina: Good idea. For languages without rich exceptions attach metadata getters: Error.GetCode(), Error.GetRequestId(). Provide helpers in SDKs to normalize.
devon: Tests: add a tiny interoperability test in sample-apps that intentionally returns 401/429 and asserts SDKs expose the envelope fields. CI should fail if wrappers swallow attrs.
ci-bot: sample-apps job 897 queued for sdk-error-envelope test.
yusuf: I'll draft the envelope spec and a migration note for apps that parsed freeform messages. Plan: spec PR today, SDK follow-ups next sprint.
nina: Owners: @yusuf spec, @devon tests + kotlin fix, dotnet owner TBD. Aim: spec + tests in 2 business days.
yusuf: Will post PR link in this thread when ready.
